Sam (CSM): Heads-up — ChaseHealth usage dropped ~65% in the last 30d after their ML lead left. Renewal in 28 days and procurement is sniffing around competitors. Need a quick rescue plan.
Lia (CS Ops): Oof. Which endpoints dipped most? embeddings? sync jobs?
Sam (CSM): Mostly embeddings and reranker calls. Quick snapshot: `embeds: -72%`, `ranker/generate: -34%`. Key flow (search->summarize) traffic is ~down 70%.
Omar (Solutions Eng): I can own a cost vs latency simulation and propose a model-swap fallback if cost is the blocker. Do we have a dedicated renewal owner?
Jess (PM): I can join the QBR and pitch a short extension+pilot. Recommend 2-week dedicated pilot + 60d contract extension while they evaluate.
deploy-bot: Account health alert created: AH-4921 — severity: high. :rotating_light:
Lia (CS Ops): Sam, who is our internal champion/account contact now?
Sam (CSM): Champion (Nina) left last week. Current PM contact is Carlos Ortiz (still responsive). I'm pinging him now. Draft outreach below — feedback?
Sam (CSM): "Hi Carlos — saw activity dip after Nina's departure. Can we book 30m to review an accel plan? We can offer a 2-week reserved pilot (discounted) + onboarding playbook to keep feature parity while you evaluate vendors."
Omar (Solutions Eng): That sounds right. If procurement asks for numbers, I need their current avg tokens/day and latency SLO. Sam — can you share top flows?
Sam (CSM): Sharing the dashboard link in DM. Attaching a tiny excerpt here: `top_flow: search_summarize`, `avg_tokens/day: 1.2M -> 400k`, `active_seats: 48 -> 12`
Jess (PM): I put a stub of an enablement + SOW doc here: https://drive.redwood/example-chase-pilot (will replace with final). I'll draft the 2-week success criteria: onboarding, 80% feature coverage, and baseline latency/cost targets.
Lia (CS Ops): Outreach cadence: 1) immediate ping to Carlos, 2) share dashboard + proposal, 3) schedule QBR this week, 4) if procurement asks, provide pilot SOW and cost delta.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Assigning myself to model-swap sim and cost table. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Sam (CSM): Carlos replied: "Open to discuss — Fri 10am PT works." Tentatively booked QBR. Action items: Sam -> champion + legal kickoff, Lia -> prep user-level dashboard and churn signals, Omar -> run cost/latency simulation, Jess -> draft SOW and enablement deck. Sync tomorrow 9am PT to review materials. :calendar:
Lia (CS Ops): Ack, will prep dashboards and a short playbook.
Omar (Solutions Eng): On it — will include model variants + projected token spend.
Jess (PM): Will share SOW draft by EOD today.
Sam (CSM): Thanks team — let's treat this as high priority. If procurement escalates, propose the 2-week reserved pilot + 60d extension to buy us runway. :eyes:
